marketing_description: The Philips 573451 LED Filament Bulb is a 40 W, 2700 lm solution with a warm white light appearance of 2700 K, offering a medium bulb shape with an E26 base. This bulb features a clear finish, a color rendering index of 90, and a beam angle of 300 degrees, making it suitable for various applications. With an average life of 15000 hours, this bulb is also energy efficient, long lasting, dimmable, easy to install, environmentally friendly, and cost effective.
